spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin after a new 20-day high close beyond the prior marker when the prior marker was at least 3 sessions earlier, with stop below the signal extreme and exit within 2-6 bars.
assumptions: Timeframe 1d from page chart; no timeframe in claim text.
Direction long: claim says buy entry on new high/low watermark.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: exact prior watermark distance of at least 3 sessions and exact stop below signal-bar extreme; approximated with no breakout on prior 2 bars and a fixed percent stop.
Entry fill at next open stands in for next-day placement at prior watermark.
Exit within 2-6 bars represented by max_hold_bars 4 with candidates 2-6.
Stop value chosen; claim gives no percent.

evidence.quote: previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
previous high/low marker must have been at least 3 trading sessions prior
Stop entries for failed trades are placed below the latest high/low that triggered the signal
Profits/exits should be taken within 2-6 candlestick intervals

audit_majors: entry[0]: close gt highest_high(20) offset 0 includes the current bar, so high >= close makes the condition nearly impossible. Claim requires close beyond the *previous* 20-day watermark, i.e. comparison to prior window, not including current bar.

entry: Claim triggers on a new 20-day high OR a new 20-day low (buy after either), spec encodes only the high breakout and omits the symmetric low trigger: new 20-day low with close below prior marker.

stop_loss_pct: Claim requires stop below the latest high/low extreme that triggered the signal (a price-level structural stop). Spec substitutes an invented fixed 3% stop. Noted as NOT EXPRESSIBLE but leaving it out changes what is tested.
